biggest_catch: First Citizens Bank (firstcitizens.com) has no checking-account cash bonus on its official site at all — the claimed $400 appears to be a mix-up with Citizens Bank (citizensbank.com), a completely different bank that does advertise a $400 bonus.
catches: No checking-account bonus exists in First Citizens Bank's official terms — the official personal checking page lists accounts, fees, and FAQs but no cash bonus promo.
The $400 checking-bonus figure matches Citizens Bank (citizensbank.com, Providence RI), a different institution — conflating the two would send users to the wrong bank's terms.
Even third-party aggregators list no current First Citizens checking bonus (creditdonkey shows no checking promo, only a $25 savings bonus and expired offers).

First Citizens checking accounts carry monthly fees (e.g. $18 Premier / $25 Prestige, waivable with balance/direct-deposit thresholds) — irrelevant to a bonus that does not exist, but relevant if a user opens an account expecting one.

c2.evidence: FAIL — the official First Citizens checking page states no bonus at all: no amount, no rate, no minimum. There is no official 'new account bonus' offer to evaluate; the route's claimed $400 has no official-terms basis.

c3.evidence: No bonus means no upfront fee is at issue; no required purchase exists in official terms.

c4.evidence: FAIL — no payout quote exists: the official personal checking page (firstcitizens.com/personal/checking) contains no bonus offer, no bonus amount, and no bonus terms.

eligibility: N/A for the bonus — no bonus exists. For the accounts themselves, official terms require age 18+, U.S. citizen/resident alien, and residence in a served state (AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, HI, KS, MD, MA, MO, NE, NV, NM, NC, OK, OR, SC, TN, TX, VA, WA, WV, or WI).
notes: REJECT is a verifiability verdict, not a scam flag: First Citizens Bank is legitimate, but it offers no official checking bonus — the strict checklist requires a concrete payout in official terms and none exists. The claimed '$400 First Citizens Bank checking bonus' is very likely a confusion with Citizens Bank (citizensbank.com), which does run an official '$400 bonus when you open a new checking account' promo (open 7/1/26–9/30/26, $1,000+ single direct deposit within 60 days). If the route was meant to be Citizens Bank, it should be renamed and re-verified against citizensbank.com. Do not list R0076 as verified under the First Citizens name.
